append_only_policy: Append-only ledger of all internal and external audit defects from Phase 01 onward. Historical entries must never be deleted, and VERIFIED requires an executed regression test.

reproduction_steps: Submit ambiguous chat text such as 'ok', 'lanjutkan', or negated sentence 'Saya tidak setuju paket v1' to approval parser.
defects.observed_result: Substring-based early prototypes risked treating casual confirmation or negated sentences as production approval.
defects.expected_result: Only structured XDX-APPROVE commands bound to project_id, package_version, SHA-256 digest, scopes, TTL, and human_user pass validation.
defects.root_cause: Lack of strict lexical negation/conditional/meta-example rejection and SHA-256 digest binding in initial prototype.
defects.correction_plan: Implemented structured XDX-APPROVE parser with negation/conditional/meta regex rejection, SHA-256 binding, TTL, and live tamper invalidation.
defects.evidence: Verified in Phase 01.5 and Phase 01.6C regression suites (negation, conditional, meta-example, and digest tamper all raise ApprovalAuthorizationError).

reproduction_steps: Generate a 12-triangle untextured PLACEHOLDER box or supply an archive containing ../ Zip-Slip traversal or loopback SSRF URL.
defects.observed_result: Simple placeholder geometry or unvalidated archive/network inputs could contaminate production assets.
defects.expected_result: Multi-component procedural geometry (>12 triangles, named sub-parts), SSRF IP/DNS blocking, Zip-Slip/Zip-Bomb blocking, and hard QC failure on PLACEHOLDER boxes.
defects.root_cause: Initial asset placeholder stub lacked semantic multi-part geometry validation and archive/network guards.
defects.correction_plan: Implemented 12-category multi-component procedural geometry, SSRF/Zip-Slip/Zip-Bomb guards, AttributionLedger, and hard PLACEHOLDER blocker.
defects.evidence: Verified across 12 procedural categories and security archive tests in test_asset_management.py and test_phase01_5_assets_compiler_and_presets.py.

reproduction_steps: Compile bpy script targeting Android Vivo X200 Pro or invoke unclassified/mutating MCP tool without authorization.
defects.observed_result: Hardcoded /tmp paths fail on Android sandboxes and unclassified MCP tools must never pass default-allow.
defects.expected_result: Generated bpy scripts use bpy.app.tempdir exclusively and XDXBlenderMCPAdapter rejects unclassified/unapproved mutating calls fail-closed.
defects.root_cause: Desktop Linux /tmp assumptions and need for strict 8-tool MCP allowlist classification.
defects.correction_plan: Enforced AST + zero-/tmp validation in BlenderXDXEngine and default-deny KNOWN_CLASSIFIED_TOOLS guard in XDXBlenderMCPAdapter.
defects.evidence: Verified AST compilation, zero /tmp paths, and fail-closed MCP tool rejection in test_phase01_5_security_and_state.py.

reproduction_steps: Attempt to load unhydrated 133-byte Git LFS pointer as MP4 or overwrite prior_analysis.* during REA v3.4 upgrade.
defects.observed_result: Unhydrated LFS pointers fail media decoding and overwriting prior_analysis.* destroys historical curation context.
defects.expected_result: Byte-size and SHA-256 verification detect LFS pointers fail-closed (ReferenceMediaIntegrityError) while preserving prior_analysis.* append-only.
defects.root_cause: Git LFS clones without git-lfs pull materialize pointer text files instead of MP4 media.
defects.correction_plan: Added LFS pointer header detection, exact byte/SHA-256 checks, and append-only side-by-side rea_analysis_v3_4.* coexistence.
defects.evidence: Both REF-001 (27,026,130B) and REF-002 (38,669,358B) SHA-256 verified alongside preserved prior_analysis.*.

reproduction_steps: Assign 'projects/p1/script.md' and './projects/p1/../p1/script.md' (or a symlink escaping workspace) to concurrent tasks.
defects.observed_result: Lexical string comparison failed to detect canonical collisions or symlink escapes and lacked OS-level cross-process locks.
defects.expected_result: Canonical realpath + prefix-walk symlink boundary enforcement and OS-level fcntl.flock single-writer locking.
defects.root_cause: Phase 01.6A compared raw relative path strings in memory without os.path.realpath or fcntl locks.
defects.correction_plan: Implemented canonicalize_artifact_path symlink walk, project output boundary check, and ArtifactOwnershipLockManager with fcntl.flock.
defects.evidence: Verified in tests 01-05 of test_phase01_6b_persistent_intelligence.py including multi-process flock contention.

reproduction_steps: Run capability discovery from Python without live host subagent invocation evidence.
defects.observed_result: Host LLM tools (invoke_subagent, etc.) were listed from static Python constants as detected capabilities.
defects.expected_result: 7-status evidence model where host LLM tools are DOCUMENTED_CAPABILITY (on matching host) or UNKNOWN unless backed by fresh CapabilityEvidence.
defects.root_cause: Python processes cannot directly introspect internal host LLM tool registries.
defects.correction_plan: Implemented 7-status RuntimeCapabilityDiscovery with TTL-bound CapabilityEvidence validation.
defects.evidence: Verified in test_10 and test_11 of test_phase01_6b_persistent_intelligence.py.

reproduction_steps: Submit review report with fresh_context_confirmed=True boolean but no runtime invocation_receipt or with same conversation_id as producer.
defects.observed_result: Self-asserted boolean flag was insufficient to prove isolated reviewer execution.
defects.expected_result: Mandatory invocation_receipt with distinct conversation_id (for native_subagent) and pre/post SHA-256 artifact equality.
defects.root_cause: Reliance on unverified boolean field in early review report contract.
defects.correction_plan: Hardened review_report.schema.json and verify_independent_review_pass with receipt and conversation isolation checks.
defects.evidence: Verified in tests 06-09 of test_phase01_6b_persistent_intelligence.py.

reproduction_steps: Pass a task handoff with initial status='COMPLETED' (or an unsealed/cross-project/mismatched-graph resume_state) into TaskDependencyScheduler.execute_dag().
defects.observed_result: Scheduler seeded completed set directly from handoff['status'] == 'COMPLETED', returning overall_status='SUCCEEDED' with zero worker calls and zero output files.
defects.expected_result: Reject non-PENDING/READY initial statuses (InitialCompletedStatusRejectedError) and restore COMPLETED exclusively from a SHA-256-sealed checkpoint bound to project_id, task_graph_digest, task_definition_digest, invocation receipt, and live disk output hashes.
defects.root_cause: execute_dag trusted caller-supplied initial task['status'] and did not cryptographically bind resume_state to a sealed source checkpoint and task graph fingerprint.
defects.correction_plan: Enforced ALLOWED_INITIAL_TASK_STATUSES={'PENDING','READY'}, added task_identity.py digests, and implemented _validate_and_bind_resume_state() in TaskDependencyScheduler and CheckpointManager.
defects.evidence: Verified in Phase 01.6C tests 01-04 (initial COMPLETED, unverified checkpoint, cross-project checkpoint, and task graph mismatch all rejected fail-closed).

reproduction_steps: Define done_when with json_schema_valid (without schema target), sha256_verified, pytest_pass, no_unapproved_mutation, or an unsupported check_type, or return unrelated 5-char filler evidence / mismatched receipt output hashes.
defects.observed_result: Phase 01.6B scheduler only checked file_exists_nonempty, silently ignored other check_types, accepted any >=5-char string as evidence, and did not compare receipt.output_artifact_hashes or worker identity against disk/handoff.
defects.expected_result: Deterministic handler registry for all 6 check_types, BLOCKED status on unsupported check_type, rejection of missing schema target, rejection of unrelated evidence, and strict worker identity + receipt output SHA-256 verification.
defects.root_cause: Incomplete done_when loop in dependency_scheduler.py and count/length-only evidence check.
defects.correction_plan: Created AcceptanceCriteriaEngine with 6 handlers, UnsupportedAcceptanceCheckError -> BLOCKED routing, anchor-bound evidence verification, and receipt identity/hash validation.
defects.evidence: Verified in Phase 01.6C tests 05-09 covering all 6 check_types, missing schema target, unsupported check -> BLOCKED, unrelated evidence, and receipt identity/hash mismatches.

reproduction_steps: Invoke independent reviewer without a pre-sealed Master Director criteria manifest and allow reviewer report to omit or rename mandatory criteria or omit failed criteria from defects.
defects.observed_result: TaskDependencyScheduler called verify_independent_review_pass without passing authoritative required_criteria_ids, letting reviewer reports define their own criteria list.
defects.expected_result: Master Director seals ImmutableReviewCriteriaManifest (SHA-256) prior to review; reviewer cannot drop/rename criteria, all 11 review bindings are verified, and every failed criterion must report a defect.
defects.root_cause: Missing immutable pre-review criteria manifest contract between Master Director and Independent Verifier.
defects.correction_plan: Implemented ImmutableReviewCriteriaManifest, ReviewerCriteriaManipulationError, 11-way review report schema & runtime binding, and mandatory defect count check.
defects.evidence: Verified in Phase 01.6C test_10 and across all 4 end-to-end 15-criterion benchmark reviews.

reproduction_steps: Truncate or corrupt latest_checkpoint.json after checkpoint_0001.json..checkpoint_0002.json were saved, then call CheckpointManager.resume().
defects.observed_result: resume() failed immediately on corrupted latest_checkpoint.json without falling back to checkpoint_0002.json and lacked explicit lineage/provenance.
defects.expected_result: Automatic fallback to newest previous SHA-256-verified checkpoint, healing latest_checkpoint.json, recording lineage & artifact provenance, and supporting secret-scanned portable bundles.
defects.root_cause: load_verified_checkpoint only read latest_checkpoint.json without walking versioned checkpoint history.
defects.correction_plan: Implemented load_latest_or_fallback_checkpoint(), checkpoint_lineage, durable_artifact_provenance, and export/import_portable_bundle().
defects.evidence: Verified automatic fallback from corrupted latest_checkpoint.json to previous valid checkpoint and secret-scanned bundle roundtrip.

reproduction_steps: Run pytest in a non-Antigravity container (where /opt/antigravity and ~/.gemini/jetski do not exist).
defects.observed_result: Two capability tests failed because they asserted DOCUMENTED_CAPABILITY unconditionally even when host markers were absent and RuntimeCapabilityDiscovery returned UNKNOWN.
defects.expected_result: UNKNOWN is recognized as the valid status on non-Antigravity hosts without live evidence; DOCUMENTED_CAPABILITY is used only when host-relevant documentation applies; runtime, documentation, and live evidence are separated.
defects.root_cause: Hardcoded Antigravity-host expectation in two test assertions and combined status representation.
defects.correction_plan: Separated runtime_capability_status, documentation_status, and live_invocation_evidence in RuntimeCapabilityDiscovery and updated both tests plus non-Antigravity monkeypatch regression test.
defects.evidence: Verified both under Antigravity markers and under monkeypatched non-Antigravity standalone environment.

reproduction_steps: Run pytest from an audit archive in an external container without /home/antigravity/fiankuns/xdx-blender-studio, node_modules, chromium, or synthetic.mp4.
defects.observed_result: Four tests failed due to hardcoded /home/antigravity path, unconditional Node/Chromium binary assertions, and missing synthetic.mp4 regeneration.
defects.expected_result: Portable sibling/env path resolution, conditional optional binary self-tests, and deterministic synthetic.mp4 fixture + generator.
defects.root_cause: Devbox-specific paths and archive *.mp4 exclusion stripping tests/fixtures/synthetic.mp4.
defects.correction_plan: Added ensure_deterministic_synthetic_mp4(), portable XDX_BLENDER_STUDIO_REPO resolution, conditional Node/Chromium probing, and included synthetic.mp4 in audit bundle.
defects.evidence: Verified synthetic.mp4 regeneration into clean tmp_path and 77/77 baseline pass.

reproduction_steps: Call SharedProjectStateMachine.transition('APPROVED', actor='trusted_human_approval_gate', verified_human_approval={'approved_digest': 'invalid', 'trusted_channel_verified': False}) or pass allow_phase02_roles=True.
defects.observed_result: SharedProjectStateMachine accepted arbitrary approved_digest strings, trusted_channel_verified=False, and actor labels; TaskDependencyScheduler accepted allow_phase02_roles=True.
defects.expected_result: Prior to Phase 01.6D, block all transitions to APPROVED and POST_APPROVAL_PRODUCTION_STATES, reject actor labels and agent-crafted approval dicts, and reject boolean production configuration flags.
defects.root_cause: Placeholder Phase 01.6B approval dictionary check lacked cryptographic channel verification.
defects.correction_plan: Enforced ProductionApprovalFrozenError in SharedProjectStateMachine and rejected allow_phase02_roles=True / allow_production_approval=True.
defects.evidence: Verified all untrusted approval dicts, actor labels, invalid digests, trusted_channel_verified=False, and boolean flags raise ProductionApprovalFrozenError / PhaseBoundaryExecutionBlockedError. Post-audit correction: the first 01.6C commit (7ebdb06) froze only the v4 state machine; the legacy v3.4 ProjectStateManager.record_explicit_user_approval still reached APPROVED (tracked as DEF-P016C-019). Status re-verified after the v3.4 freeze landed.

defects.affected_module: governance/trusted_approval.py, intelligence/state_and_approval.py, orchestration/shared_state.py, adapters/xdx_mcp_adapter.py, scripts/trusted_approval.py, scripts/execution_guard_hook.py
reproduction_steps: Attempt end-to-end human-signed production unlock and lifecycle hook ExecutionGuard enforcement.
defects.observed_result: Production approval is intentionally frozen in Phase 01.6C pending full Trusted Human Approval channel & lifecycle ExecutionGuard hooks.
defects.expected_result: Out-of-band human-authenticated approval token/channel bound to 13-item package SHA-256 + .agents/hooks.json runtime ExecutionGuard.
defects.root_cause: Scheduled architectural milestone boundary (Phase 01.6D).
defects.correction_plan: Phase 01.6D: central TrustedApprovalGuard (Ed25519 signed token from a human-held private key, public keys in git-pinned registry/trusted_approvers.json) used by v3.4 ProjectStateManager, v4 SharedProjectStateMachine.approve_via_trusted_gate, ApprovalGate (CLI + MCP) and a pre-tool guard hook; hash-chained ledger for single-use nonces and revocation; Phase 02 execution boundary keeps production scopes blocked. Host hook wiring tracked separately as DEF-P016D-029.
defects.evidence: Documented in docs/PHASE_01_6D_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md; remains strictly frozen in Phase 01.6C. Phase 01.6D: verified by tests/test_phase01_6d_execution_security.py (10 tests) and tests/test_phase01_5_security_and_state.py; repo registry has 0 keys so the channel is UNAVAILABLE and production BLOCKED by default.

reproduction_steps: Request a new topic such as 'Bagaimana AC mendinginkan ruangan?' without authored_payload, or pass the time-perception showcase payload with topic_title overwritten.
defects.observed_result: PreProductionPackageBuilder fell back to authored_showcase_150s and renamed topic_title, while CreativePayloadValidator pooled title|premise|claims so title-swapped scripts passed.
defects.expected_result: Transition to CREATIVE_PAYLOAD_REQUIRED when authored_payload is absent, keep authored_showcase_150s strictly for explicit test fixtures, and reject any script whose body/claims lack independent lexical overlap with topic_title.
defects.root_cause: Phase 01.5 demo fallback remained wired into PreProductionPackageBuilder and validator used union instead of independent title intersection.
defects.correction_plan: Removed showcase fallback from PreProductionPackageBuilder, added CREATIVE_PAYLOAD_REQUIRED state transition, and enforced independent title_terms overlap in CreativePayloadValidator.
defects.evidence: Verified CREATIVE_PAYLOAD_REQUIRED on missing payload and TopicRelevanceError when swapping AC/Ocean titles onto Time Perception or Social Satire fixtures.

reproduction_steps: Modify REA analyzer source or scene_threshold parameter and inspect reference analysis cache status.
defects.observed_result: persistence_probe.py used static string 'xdx-rea-video-multimodal-forensics-v3.4' as analyzer_fingerprint and SHA-256 of reference_registry.json as analyzer_config_hash.
defects.expected_result: 8-part cache key hashing actual analyzer Python source files and actual analyzer execution config parameters, invalidating cache on change while preserving prior versions.
defects.root_cause: Placeholder metadata strings used during initial KnowledgeMemory seeding.
defects.correction_plan: Implemented compute_actual_analyzer_source_fingerprint(), compute_analyzer_config_hash(), and 8-part ReferenceAnalysisCacheKey with append-only invalidation/re-analysis.
defects.evidence: Verified cache hit on identical 8-part key and deterministic CACHE_MISS_INVALIDATED + version preservation when source fingerprint or config changes.

reproduction_steps: Call record_host_subagent_completion with a hardcoded conversation_id string in standalone Python without host transcript or dispatcher proof.
defects.observed_result: Replay scripts emitted execution_mode='native_subagent' from hardcoded conversation_id constants without distinguishing recorded replay from live host invocation.
defects.expected_result: Explicitly separate 5 modes (native_subagent, recorded_workflow_replay, sequential_fallback_honest, mock_execution, dispatch_plan_only_not_invoked) and require host transcript/dispatch proof for strict native_subagent claims.
defects.root_cause: Missing recorded_workflow_replay mode and host transcript verifier.
defects.correction_plan: Added 5 execution modes, verify_host_transcript_contains_subagent(), and require_live_host_proof enforcement in NativeAgentExecutionAdapter.
defects.evidence: Verified live Antigravity transcript proof for Phase 01.6C subagents, recorded_workflow_replay mode for offline audit replay, and rejection of bare static conversation_id under require_live_host_proof=True.

reproduction_steps: Build a WAITING_APPROVAL package, then call ProjectStateManager.record_explicit_user_approval() with the package's valid XDX-APPROVE command.
Hand-write APPROVED state + approval_record.json and call ApprovalGate.verify_live_execution_context().
defects.observed_result: Legacy v3.4 path wrote approval_record.json, set current_state=APPROVED and allowed MCP_PREFLIGHT; tests/test_approval_state_rea_and_qc.py asserted this as expected behaviour.
defects.expected_result: Before Phase 01.6D every path (v3.4 and v4) validates the approval input and then refuses with ProductionApprovalFrozenError, writing nothing; forged on-disk approval cannot authorize execution or MCP mutation.
defects.root_cause: Freeze was added only to SharedProjectStateMachine; ProjectStateManager and ApprovalGate kept the Phase 01.5 happy path.
defects.correction_plan: Single ProductionApprovalFrozenError defined in state_and_approval.py (re-exported by shared_state); raise_if_production_frozen() after full validation in record_explicit_user_approval() and verify_live_execution_context(); MCP adapter maps it to MCPSceneMutationBlockedError; legacy tests now assert the freeze.
defects.evidence: Also covered by tests/test_phase01_5_security_and_state.py::test_mcp_tool_allowlist_unknown_tool_rejection_and_live_tamper_blocking, tests/test_approval_state_rea_and_qc.py::test_13_item_approval_gate_and_state_machine_across_hybrid_genres and tests/test_reference_database_integration.py::test_creative_pipeline_and_approval_gate_with_references.

reproduction_steps: Clone with GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1 (or unpack the audit bundle, which excludes the MP4s) and run pytest.
defects.observed_result: 17 tests failed with MEDIA_MISSING / INTEGRITY_FAILED, validate-all exited 1; pre-production could not run at all without 65 MB of LFS media.
defects.expected_result: Pre-production uses the reference knowledge layers without the MP4 bytes and reports media honestly as UNVERIFIED_MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE; corrupt/tampered real files still fail closed; tests that need real bytes are skipped via requires_lfs.
defects.root_cause: verify_and_load_reference() always required hydrated media, and every caller used it even when only analyses/profiles were needed.
defects.correction_plan: require_media flag (strict by default on verify_and_load_reference, knowledge-only on resolve_context); missing/pointer -> UNVERIFIED_MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE, wrong bytes -> ReferenceMediaIntegrityError in both modes; all_media_verified + reference_media_status reported; tests/conftest.py adds requires_lfs auto-skip.
defects.evidence: Full suite in a pointer-only clone: 0 failed, 1 skipped (requires_lfs). Strict mode still covered by tests/test_reference_database_integration.py::test_fail_closed_on_lfs_pointer_or_missing_media.

reproduction_steps: Run test_11 and test_24 outside an Antigravity host / without hydrated LFS media.
defects.observed_result: test_11 expected DOCUMENTED_CAPABILITY off-host (code correctly returned UNKNOWN); test_24 hard-coded git_lfs_media_hydrated is True.
defects.expected_result: Tests assert the honest, environment-derived value.
defects.root_cause: Tests were written against the Antigravity dev host with hydrated LFS.
defects.correction_plan: Host-aware expectation for test_11; test_24 compares against tests.conftest.reference_media_hydrated().
defects.evidence: Passes both on and off host; test_24 passes with and without hydrated media.

reproduction_steps: git show --stat 7ebdb06 | tail -1
defects.observed_result: Commit added ~1.65M lines; 820 per-step checkpoint_*.json files (~68 MB) plus .checkpoint.lock / *.state.lock runtime files were tracked.
defects.expected_result: Only compact evidence (latest_checkpoint.json, portable_checkpoint_bundle_v4.json) is committed; runtime checkpoints and locks are ignored.
defects.root_cause: Benchmark runner wrote into projects/ and the result was committed with git add -A.
defects.correction_plan: git rm --cached on per-step checkpoints and lock files; .gitignore rules added. Note: the blobs remain in branch history until the branch is squashed/rewritten before merge.
defects.evidence: git ls-files shows no checkpoint_NNNN.json or *.lock runtime files after the fix.

reproduction_steps: Compare registry statuses with an actual pytest run of the 7ebdb06 tree without LFS media.
defects.observed_result: 17/18 defects marked VERIFIED while 20 tests failed and DEF-P016B-014 was only partially fixed.
defects.expected_result: VERIFIED only when the referenced regression test exists and passes in a clean environment.
defects.root_cause: Statuses were set from the author's hydrated dev host, not from a clean reproduction.
defects.correction_plan: Statuses re-derived from a clean pointer-only clone run; new test enforces that every VERIFIED entry names an existing test function.
defects.evidence: Test resolves every VERIFIED regression_test node id to a real test function.

reproduction_steps: Build a package, change narration_dialogue.json (or captions, character/style bible, camera, semantic storyboard, research_report, reference_adaptation) and recompute compute_package_digest().
defects.observed_result: The approval digest hashed only 11 legacy files; 8 production-input artifacts could change after approval without invalidating it.
defects.expected_result: Canonical SHA-256 manifest over every non-runtime file, with 19 required inputs, symlink/special-file rejection and explicit runtime exclusions.
defects.root_cause: REQUIRED_PACKAGE_FILES allow-list predated the v4 artifacts.
defects.correction_plan: compute_package_digest delegates to governance/canonical_manifest.py (all files hashed; runtime state/lock/ledger and the digest-presenting approval_package_manifest.json excluded).
defects.evidence: Each of the 8 previously uncovered files and any new file changes the digest; MCP tamper test now mutates narration_dialogue.json.

reproduction_steps: Hand-write approval_record.json + APPROVED state, replay a consumed token, edit/delete the ledger, un-revoke a record, or call the v4 transition('APPROVED') with an actor label and dict.
defects.observed_result: Before 01.6D, record validation relied on an unsigned XDX-APPROVE string that any agent could produce (frozen only by the 01.6C kill switch).
defects.expected_result: Every path rejects forged, replayed, expired, revoked, scope-mismatched and post-approval-tampered approvals; CLI and MCP cannot bypass.
defects.root_cause: No authenticated human channel; approval state was trusted from writable files.
defects.correction_plan: verify_live_execution_context / transition / inspect_package all re-verify the signed token, ledger (exactly-once consumption, revocation) and live manifest; nonces also kept in state history so deleting the ledger cannot enable replay.
defects.evidence: Also tests/test_phase01_6d_execution_security.py::test_v4_state_machine_only_accepts_trusted_gate, ::test_mcp_mutation_never_executes_in_phase_01_6d, tests/test_phase01_5_security_and_state.py::test_invalid_state_transitions_ai_self_approval_expiry_and_revocation.

reproduction_steps: Inspect projects/bench_*/narration_dialogue.json estimated_timing and the recorded CRIT_06_NARRATION_TIMING verdict.
defects.observed_result: All four 01.6C benchmarks overrun target (A 64.4/60s, B 67.9/60s, C 189.9/180s, D 50.0/45s) yet CRIT_06 was PASS; estimator called up to +15% 'comfortable'.
defects.expected_result: Estimated duration above target x 1.02 is EXCEEDS_TARGET and CRIT_06 FAILS (shorten or change target; never speed up audio).
defects.root_cause: CRIT_06 checked only WPM and speed multiplier; estimator tolerance was 15%.
defects.correction_plan: NARRATION_DURATION_TOLERANCE=0.02; duration_fit_status/duration_limit_s emitted; CRIT_06 requires within_target. Stored 01.6C benchmark reviews are now known-invalid for CRIT_06 and must be regenerated in a later phase (not re-run here per quota rules).
defects.evidence: Replay of benchmark A at 60s now fails TASK-15-VERIFY; at the estimator-recommended 70s it passes. tests/test_phase01_6d_execution_security.py::test_narration_estimate_over_target_is_not_pass.

reproduction_steps: XDX_TEST_PROFILE=full_integration pytest in a clone without hydrated LFS media.
defects.observed_result: requires_lfs tests were skipped in every profile, so a Full Integration run could pass with no reference media.
defects.expected_result: Core profile: skip without media. Full Integration profile: missing/unhydrated media is a FAILURE; SHA-256 of both MP4s verified.
defects.root_cause: Single skip rule for all environments.
defects.correction_plan: XDX_TEST_PROFILE=full_integration turns requires_lfs items into hard failures when media is absent.
defects.evidence: Full Integration run with real MP4s (REF-001 12f9e1d9..., REF-002 042ad39d...) and a negative run without media are recorded in docs/evidence/phase01_6d/AUDIT_PHASE_01_6D.md.

reproduction_steps: Re-measure the reported 109/109 action-target coverage of the 01.6C semantic storyboard with criteria independent of the generator.
defects.observed_result: 01.6C reports 109/109 action targets satisfied; the external audit does not accept this self-reported figure as proof of semantic coverage.
defects.expected_result: Action-target coverage measured by an independent checker against script clauses, with failures surfaced.
defects.root_cause: Coverage metric computed by the same component that produced the plan.
defects.correction_plan: Carried forward unchanged (out of 01.6D security scope).
defects.evidence: Preserved from the external 01.6C audit per owner instruction; target assigned to Phase 02B (action target).

reproduction_steps: Inspect Antigravity remote devbox .agents/ and ~/.gemini/ for documented host pre-tool lifecycle hook runtime capable of automatically invoking scripts/execution_guard_hook.py before run_command/MCP calls.
defects.observed_result: scripts/execution_guard_hook.py exists and is hardened, but this Antigravity remote devbox exposes only .agents/{agents,rules,skills} with NO documented or verifiable host pre-tool hook runtime that intercepts tool calls automatically.
defects.expected_result: Host pre-tool hook runtime automatically invokes scripts/execution_guard_hook.py for every terminal, renderer, and MCP call with live interception proof.
defects.root_cause: Host runtime does not expose a documented/verifiable native pre-tool hook configuration format on this devbox.
defects.correction_plan: Keep host-level automatic enforcement honestly marked BLOCKED until verified on a host with documented lifecycle hooks; enforce Python-level TrustedApprovalGuard + dependency verification on all renderer entrypoints.
defects.evidence: Host inspection of .agents/ and ~/.gemini/ confirmed no host hook runner; guard logic tested in Python only (not claiming host-level interception).

reproduction_steps: Seed known semantic-storyboard defects and measure how many the independent reviewer reports (precision/recall).
defects.observed_result: External audit flagged semantic storyboard quality and reviewer accuracy as unproven; DEF-P016D-026 is one concrete instance of the reviewer passing a real defect.
defects.expected_result: Reviewer accuracy measured on a seeded-defect benchmark; semantic storyboard checks independent of the generator.
defects.root_cause: Reviewer criteria validated only on happy-path packages.
defects.correction_plan: Addressed incrementally in Phase 02A (4-shot AC semantic storyboard + explicit object interaction targets) through Phase 03 (seeded-defect reviewer benchmark).
defects.evidence: Preserved per owner instruction; 4-shot AC benchmark semantic alignment upgraded in Phase 02A.

reproduction_steps: Export a portable checkpoint bundle on one VM and resume on a different VM.
defects.observed_result: Recovery and persistence verified only on the same host (subprocesses / directories); cross-VM recovery has no runtime evidence.
defects.expected_result: Multi-host resume test with recorded evidence before claiming cross-VM persistence.
defects.root_cause: Single-host test environment.
defects.correction_plan: Carried forward; must be verified before full production rollout.
defects.evidence: docs/evidence/checkpoint_recovery_report_v4.json recovery_scope_disclaimer.

reproduction_steps: Modify registry/trusted_approvers.json and run local git commit inside the agent VM without remote user push/review, then call TrustedApprovalGuard.channel_status().
defects.observed_result: Phase 01.6D _registry_git_state() checked only git diff HEAD, so an unpushed local agent commit could appear CLEAN.
defects.expected_result: Local unpushed modifications relative to @{upstream} or mismatch against out-of-band XDX_TRUSTED_REGISTRY_SHA256 pin mark the channel UNAVAILABLE (BLOCKED).
defects.root_cause: Local HEAD cleanliness does not guarantee independent human review if the agent has local git commit capability.
defects.correction_plan: Added @{upstream} diff check (LOCAL_UNPUSHED -> UNAVAILABLE) and XDX_TRUSTED_REGISTRY_SHA256 pin check; pending regression test verification.
defects.evidence: Verified local-unpushed @{upstream} guard and out-of-band XDX_TRUSTED_REGISTRY_SHA256 pin in test_p02a_02 (15/15 security tests passing).

reproduction_steps: Invoke TrustedApprovalGuard.consume() concurrently from multiple processes using the same single-use signed approval token.
defects.observed_result: Phase 01.6D read_ledger -> check nonce -> _append_ledger lacked cross-process file locking, risking double-consume TOCTOU and hash-chain corruption.
defects.expected_result: OS-level fcntl.flock exclusive lock guarantees atomic single-use consumption across concurrent processes with intact hash chain.
defects.root_cause: Missing fcntl.flock lock around approval_ledger.jsonl read/check/append.
defects.correction_plan: Added _ledger_lock() using fcntl.flock on .approvals/approval_ledger.lock and verified across 6 parallel processes.
defects.evidence: Verified in 6-process spawn pool: exactly 1 CONSUMED, 5 ApprovalReplayError, and intact 1-entry hash chain.

reproduction_steps: Pass CommandLine with 'npx remotion render', 'node engines/web/three_deterministic_scene.mjs', 'ffmpeg -i ... out.mp4', or 'python3 -c "...remotion..."' to scripts/execution_guard_hook.py.
defects.observed_result: Phase 01.6D _RENDER_CMD regex checked only 'command' key and narrow patterns ('blender -b', 'remotion render', 'ffmpeg projects/.../renders/'), missing Antigravity CommandLine and renderer/shell bypasses.
defects.expected_result: Guard inspects both CommandLine and command, blocks all Three.js/Remotion/FFmpeg/Blender/indirection render invocations and trust-registry shell tampering.
defects.root_cause: Narrow regex and missing Antigravity CommandLine field handling.
defects.correction_plan: Expanded _RENDER_CMD and _TRUST_TAMPER_CMD in scripts/execution_guard_hook.py and added fail-closed assert_render_authorized in engines/web_engines.py.
defects.evidence: Verified all 6 shell/renderer/trust-tamper bypass commands blocked and assert_render_authorized raises PhaseBoundaryBlockedError.

reproduction_steps: Modify engines/web/three_deterministic_scene.mjs or package.json after human approval of a package_dir.
defects.observed_result: Canonical manifest hashed files inside package_dir only, leaving external renderer scripts, package-lock.json, and REF-002 profile outside the signed digest.
defects.expected_result: production_dependencies.json inside package_dir pins SHA-256 of all external renderer/lockfile/reference dependencies and is verified live before execution.
defects.root_cause: External repo dependencies live outside projects/<id>/.
defects.correction_plan: Added build_production_dependencies_manifest() and verify_production_dependencies() in governance/canonical_manifest.py and pinned 11 dependencies in bench_p02a_ac_15s.
defects.evidence: Verified 11 external dependencies pinned in bench_p02a_ac_15s canonical manifest and post-pinning file mutation raises CanonicalManifestError.

reproduction_steps: Render the AC 15s benchmark through RemotionEngine.compile_master_composition() and probe the MP4 with ffprobe/volumedetect.
defects.observed_result: Composition always carried an AAC audioSpec (-15 LUFS) although no audio stage exists, so the first test render shipped a 15s digitally silent track (max_volume -91 dB); QC had no notion of a visual-only delivery.
defects.expected_result: Phase 02A exports VISUAL_ONLY_BENCHMARK renders without an audio track (renderMedia muted:true); a missing track is not a defect, a silent track is a low WARN, the MASTER_WITH_AUDIO profile keeps strict audio rules for Phase 04.
defects.root_cause: Phase 02A design bundled audio mixing into the visual milestone.
defects.correction_plan: governance/phase_scope.py delivery profiles + audio_policy; Remotion composition defaults to muted with audioSpec None; VisualQualityControlEngine(delivery_profile=...) with measure_audio_peak_db(); qc_report.schema.json audio_policy block.
defects.evidence: Synthetic no-audio MP4 -> PASS, silent AAC -> WARN DEF_UNNECESSARY_SILENT_AUDIO_TRACK, MASTER profile -> HARD_FAIL; user test render -> WARN (peak -91.0 dBFS) instead of a fail.

reproduction_steps: Run VisualQualityControlEngine on the first AC 15s test render (primitive props, debug overlays, louvers never open).
defects.observed_result: Technical QC only measures decode, luma, contrast and blank frames, so a render whose shots do not show what the captions say, with placeholder primitives and burned-in debug labels, is not rejected.
defects.expected_result: An independent fresh-context reviewer must confirm, per shot and per required action derived from the signed storyboard/semantic plan/captions, that the action is visible; placeholder assets, debug overlays, render artifacts, low dimension scores or a weak REF-002 comparison block PASS.
defects.root_cause: No semantic caption-to-visual gate between technical QC and acceptance.
defects.correction_plan: build_visual_review_checklist() + evaluate_visual_review() (reviewer != producer, render SHA-256 binding, 3 frames per shot, 7 visual dimensions, REF-002 comparison) and scripts/visual_review.py checklist|frames|evaluate.
defects.evidence: docs/evidence/phase02a_visual_only/independent_visual_qc_result_ac15s.json: first test render HARD_FAIL (12 semantic mismatches, 5 placeholder assets, 4 debug overlays, REF-002 mean 1.417/5). Reviewer precision/recall is still tracked by DEF-P016D-030.

reproduction_steps: Send creative_generate_speech or 'rhubarb ... vo.wav' to the execution guard hook during Phase 02A.
defects.observed_result: Nothing prevented agents from spending quota on TTS, music, SFX, lip sync or audio mixing during the visual milestone.
defects.expected_result: Audio tools and audio shell tooling are blocked with PhaseScopeDeferredError until Phase 04; the render approval gate is unchanged.
defects.root_cause: Scope existed only as prose.
defects.correction_plan: classify_audio_tool()/classify_audio_command() checked in the hook before the render gate.
defects.evidence: Hook exit 2 for audio tool/command, exit 0 for 'ls', exit 2 (trusted approval missing) for a muted Remotion render.

defects.affected_module: engines/web/ (Three.js scenes), asset pipeline, render composition
reproduction_steps: Inspect frames listed by scripts/visual_review.py checklist projects/bench_p02a_ac_15s on the first AC 15s render.
defects.observed_result: Character and props are primitives (floating cylinder arm, box remote, box compressor, cylinder condenser); louvers never open; no directed heat flow; stray grey plane in S003; debug labels burned in; flat lighting without shadows; static cameras and hard cuts; no 24 C payoff.
defects.expected_result: Re-render passes evaluate_visual_review() with PASS: all required actions visible, no placeholders/overlays/artifacts, every dimension >= 3.0, shot mean >= 3.5, REF-002 mean >= 3.0.
defects.root_cause: Visual production quality not yet built; previously undetected by QC (DEF-P02A-037).
defects.correction_plan: Phase 02A visual work: production-grade low-poly character with rig, articulated AC with animated louvers, readable mechanism cutaways, lighting/shadows/materials, camera moves and transitions, overlays off in final render. Progress 2026-11-28: engines/web/phase02a_ac15s (rigged stylized Bima with hands/face/expressions, articulated AC with rotating louver and display, evaporator cutaway with copper coil/fins/blower and refrigerant phase change, wall cross-section with compressor/condenser/fan, directed heat and cool airflow, PCF soft shadows, textured materials, per-shot camera moves, content callouts, no debug overlays) rendered via scripts/render_phase02a_visual.py.
defects.evidence: Independent review HARD_FAIL recorded in docs/evidence/phase02a_visual_only/. Prototype v2 (NON_PRODUCTION_PROTOTYPE, 450 frames, no audio track): technical QC PASS, docs/evidence/phase02a_visual_only/prototype_v2_contact_sheet.jpg; owner reviewed and approved the visual direction in chat. Independent visual review (reviewer != producer) still pending, so the defect stays open.
